source: data/strand-v2 (scripts/strand-export.ts --rule-table, Spectacle ee35c24): rules-hex.json and boards.npz (L2 / L3 / L4full, the Delta patch of each level)

conventions.geo: type * 12 + rot * 2 + (mirror < 0), -1 off the board; row = r - r0, col = q - q0
conventions.tile: Spectacle's tile index in the patch (buildField({family: 'hex', level, rootTile: root}), flatten order) of each cell, -1 off the board
conventions.tile_rot: board direction of local edge k = (board_mirror * k + tile_rot) mod 6 (as v1)
conventions.split: subsets[].split = per subset the round(0.2 * n) rules with the smallest (fmix32(FNV-1a('strand-split-v2|' + key)), index): held out in the class-0 subsets; 15 / 128 / 258 hold out the v1 legacy rules instead (nca/strand/rules.py)
